summary: TROOPS, Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K current report) disclosing board and officer changes effective October 15, 2026. Independent director Mr. Li Wang Tai Dominic resigned for personal reasons, with no disagreement cited, and the board appointed Mr. Jacopo Visetti, co-founder of blockchain energy platform EFFORCE, to fill the vacancy. The board separately appointed Mr. Sergio Carloni, EFFORCE's CEO, as Chief Operating Officer. No related-party transactions, arrangements, or compensatory terms were disclosed. Watch for governance drift and any strategic pivot toward blockchain energy assets.
